coordinate_frame: Existing Railyards v3 frame: X east, Y north, Z up; rail cutting centered near X=-119; river west/east edges near X=128/191.

sources.role: Bridge-facing A3 view; resolves enclosed pedestrian bridge glazing and the foreground Roosevelt bridge silhouette.
North B4 aerial; resolves the primary rail crossings, landing direction, and rail/transit relationship.
South B6 aerial; resolves three total rail crossings including the southern district crossing.

pedestrian_crossings.name: south district crossing
pedestrian_crossings.evidence: B6 south view shows the southern covered rail crossing; west landing is a source-inferred district concourse because no west-side building footprint is modeled at this Y.

pedestrian_crossings.name: medical main crossing
pedestrian_crossings.evidence: B4 north view; west end is buried into the Medical main footprint and east end into the stadium concourse.

pedestrian_crossings.name: medical wing crossing
pedestrian_crossings.evidence: North source bridge roof pixels (1400,437),(1390,452),(1240,553) intersect z26.2 at Y195-200; replacement Y198 bridges the source-projected wing and pavilion/hall landing.

roosevelt.evidence: A3 foreground and existing Roosevelt registration resolve a dark closed road deck, a large pale under-deck arch springing near the water-side banks, thin upper rail, paired bank tender houses, and center seam.
inferred: Exact arch section, structural member spacing, and hinge machinery are schematic.
Bridge remains closed because no source view resolves an open/raised state.

southern_rail_bridges.evidence: AECOM south aerial foreground structure projects to the B&OCT span; LOC HAER IL-67 documents the B&OCT bridge with the adjacent St. Charles Air Line bridge beyond.

excluded: The old four-copy baseline at Y=-113,-48,73,150 is not retained.
No additional crossings are added where the September proposal views do not resolve one.
